desc: Enhance Rebirth to rebirth at 8th level.
Immunity to destruction by Hand of Purity/Putrefaction
Resistance to Avenging Spirit - instead of being slain you are only knocked unconscious for 5 minutes
Resistance (½ effect) to "Wrath of the Lord" miracle
¼ Effect from one element, from ½ effect
Immunity to Bruising using MAC and DAC vs. Pure Magic blows
Immunity to Bruising using SAC and DAC vs. Pure Spirit blows

Strike to Stun, as Halt miracle, but it is physical in origin, it will "Halt" a target of 9 levels or lower for ten seconds or until struck.
Requires a non damaging blow to inflict, immunity to halt applies.
Enhance all of characters Strike to Stun abilities, if bought from above to no level/hit limit

Enhanced Distancing Combat. Unarmed attacks reduced from -6 pts  damage to -9pts damage. O-class weapon attack reduced by -3 pts damage.
Must have Distancing Combat and use a B-class weapon
May now read spiritual scrolls of own alignment (Good/Evil/Neutral) of  up to 4th level.
